description: Pakistan's clearing-layer data as a local research panel with a coverage audit and an arithmetic self-check, not another dashboard.

novel_features.name: Arithmetic invariant validator
novel_features.description: Prove a date's flow numbers are internally consistent before they reach a regression.

novel_features.name: Per-resource coverage and gap ledger
novel_features.description: List which sessions are missing per resource, how stale each one is, and how wide each date's data actually is.

novel_features.name: Live endpoint self-test
novel_features.description: Assert every endpoint family still answers correctly for a date it just reported as its own latest.

novel_features.name: Vintage-stamped research panel export
novel_features.description: Emit any synced resource as a tidy long-format panel, with gaps marked rather than filled.

novel_features.name: Point-in-time symbol roster
novel_features.description: Reconstruct which symbols were listed and clearing-eligible on any past date.

novel_features.name: Risk-parameter change detector
novel_features.description: Date every step change in a symbol's free float, VAR margin and haircut.

novel_features.name: Unified leverage and short-interest panel
novel_features.description: Join MTS, MFS and MSF open positions with SLB net open position into one per-symbol cross-section.

novel_features.name: Gate-free FIPI/LIPI flow feed
novel_features.description: Fetch daily FIPI/LIPI sector flows into the local store without a browser.

novel_features.name: Browser-capture ingest
novel_features.description: Load NCCPL responses captured through your own browser into the same local store.

novel_features.name: Browser-assisted capture
novel_features.description: Fetch the gated NCCPL datasets through a controlled browser and store them locally; opt in with --launch, and add --headless to run with no window.
